metric_notes.extractive_groundedness: Lexical overlap diagnostic for extractive text; not LLM faithfulness.
metric_notes.query_context_similarity: Query-to-extractive-context cosine similarity; not generated-answer relevancy.
metric_notes.evidence_recall: Whole-token content-word coverage; exact-token matching, no substrings.

benchmark_scope.dedup_key: experiment_key: config minus generation dimension (the generator is never invoked by this benchmark)
